characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Young Indian woman with a slim build and medium complexion. She has long, dark, straight hair parted down the middle. Her facial features are expressive with dark eyes.
characters.wardrobe: A blue and white vertically striped button-down shirt.
characters.demeanor: Conversational, initially skeptical but becoming convinced and engaged.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Not physically present; represented on-screen by a circular blue robot icon.

scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: I can read and write English perfectly fine.
Miss Nova says: But when it is time to actually speak English, do you freeze?
Priya says: Yes! I get so shy. I have tried so many courses, but nothing works.
Miss Nova says: Because in those courses, you never actually spoke. I am Miss Nova, an AI teacher on Supernova AI.
Priya says: An AI teacher? How can an AI teach me to speak?
Miss Nova says: I do not just give you generic lessons. I listen to you speak, find exactly where you struggle, and build a personalized plan just for you.
Priya says: But what if I make mistakes? I feel embarrassed.
Miss Nova says: You can practice with me at two in the morning. Make a thousand mistakes, and I will correct you without ever judging or laughing at you.
Priya says: Really? And you explain things so I can understand?
Miss Nova says: Yes, I explain the logic right in your own language. Over one crore Indians are already practicing with me.
Priya says: That sounds amazing.
Miss Nova says: Stop wasting hours scrolling through videos. Just practice speaking with me for fifteen minutes a day. Install Supernova AI and start speaking today.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hooks with the relatable reading vs speaking gap.
- Introduces Miss Nova and handles the AI objection with personalization (beat a).
- Delivers the privacy/no-judgement reassurance (beat b) and closes with the 15-min daily anchor.
